messages:
jonathan: FYI customer T-4892 seeing ~2.8% 502s from hosted /v1/generate starting ~2024-11-12T10:12Z. Happens across regions but concentrated on us-west-2. Quote from payload: 'stream dropped mid-chunk'. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/T-4892
noah (support): Can you paste a request id or sample curl? Customer included trace id: trace=tx:0a7c8f9d. quick repro I ran: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx" -d '{"model":"gpt-open","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate``` returns 502 with no body.
maria (oncall): Pulling traces now. Observability shows a spike in edge gateway 502s at 10:12:18 -> upstream reset, and a cluster of h2 GOAWAY / RST_STREAM events. Looks like midproxy -> model-pool path seeing conn window/keepalive churn.
irene: checked billing/auth services (token validation + billing). No elevated errors or auth 401s around that time. KMS and customer key rotations were quiet.
jonathan: customer mentioned they rotated API keys ~10:05, but they used old key in the repro. Not sure relevant.
noah (support): Added repro steps from the customer: high QPS small payloads + occasional long-lived streaming responses. They saw more 502s when streams were >30s.
ben (edge): I pulled edge logs: excerpt from envoy: ```[2024-11-12T10:12:18.453Z] upstream reset: connection failure, error_code=ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM, details=stream window exceeded``` Also see keepalive ping failures: "timeout waiting for GOAWAY ack" in midproxy logs.
maria (oncall): Hypothesis: h2 connection window / keepalive mismatch between midproxy and model pool causing early reset under mixed long/short streams. Could be exacerbated by auth token swap causing active connections to be drained.
jonathan: Customer timeline matches token swap + rotations (they confirmed). Could be thundering reconnects + window drift.
noah (support): Quick mitigation suggestions? Customer is on hosted API and needs immediate relief.
ben (edge): Short term: 1) Enable per-tenant short-circuit fallback to a compatible model variant (lower concurrency) for that tenant. 2) Increase h2 keepalive interval/timeout on midproxy for 10 minutes to let streams finish. 3) Roll out a canary config to 10% of edge hosts.
maria (oncall): I'll do (2) and (3) for canary now. Patching midproxy config on canary: ```kubectl -n edge patch cm midproxy-config --patch '{"keepaliveTimeout":"30s","maxConcurrentStreams":200}'```
deploy-bot: rolling canary deploy: midproxy-config -> edge-canary-1 (3 pods). change id: cfg-20241112-keepalive.
observability-bot: canary metrics from edge-canary-1: 502 rate down from 2.8% -> 0.4% within 90s. latency stable.
irene: I also disabled aggressive auth-drain for the customer's tenant for 15m (prevents connection flush on token rotation).
jonathan: Customer confirmed error rate dropped and streaming completes now. They sent logs showing no 502s after 10:15. :relieved:
maria (oncall): Good. Next steps (for eng-sre/edge): 1) reproduce in staging with mixed long/short streams + token rotation. 2) Add guardrail to avoid simultaneous token swap + aggressive conn-drain. 3) Audit h2 window defaults across midproxy/modelpool and add alert for GOAWAY/RST spike. 4) Add small e2e test for streaming keepalive window.
ben (edge): I'll take reproducer + config tuning. assigning to #eng-runtime and will link PR with config defaults.
noah (support): I'll update ticket T-4892 with customer repro and mitigation steps, and propose follow-up timeline.
jonathan: Thanks all. Marking resolved for customer for now, keeping P1 -> P2 follow-up.
maria (oncall): leaving this thread open for postmortem doc draft. add me if you need logs/trace ids. :white_check_mark:
